# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We release patches for security vulnerabilities for the current minor version and the previous minor version.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| latest  | :white_check_mark: |
| previous minor | :white_check_mark: |
| older   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

- **Email:** Report to the maintainers via the contact method listed on [rnix.ai](https://rnix.ai) or the repository owner.
- We will acknowledge receipt and work on a fix; we may ask for more details.
- After a fix is released, we can coordinate on disclosure (e.g. CVE, advisory).

Thank you for helping keep Rnix and its users safe.
